title: Show a separator between Pinned and non-pinned applications
line: The Icons-Only Task Manager now shows a thin separator between pinned apps and other running apps.
explanation: In the Icons-Only Task Manager, pinned apps (and their running windows) always stay in a block at the start, and other apps can't be dragged in among them, but nothing on screen showed where that block ends. The change works out where the pinned apps end and, when other apps follow, leaves a small gap after the last pinned app with a thin line in it (Plasma's usual widgets/line, half the task's height), horizontal panels and vertical panels alike. It updates as apps are pinned, unpinned, opened or closed.

commits.message:
applets/taskmanager: show a separator between pinned and other apps

The Icons-Only Task Manager gave no hint of where pinned apps end, so it
was unclear why a running app can't be dragged in among them. Leave a
small gap after the last pinned app and draw a thin line in it.

BUG: 459648

media.caption: Bottom panel on master: pinned System Settings, Discover, Dolphin (running) and Chrome run straight into unpinned Konsole and System Monitor.
Same apps with the fix: a thin line in a small gap after Chrome, the last pinned app.
Left (vertical) panel on master: no break between pinned Dolphin and unpinned Konsole.
Vertical panel with the fix: a horizontal line between pinned Dolphin and Konsole.
